name: car-dealership-crm
description: Universal Car Dealership CRM and Enterprise Management Platform

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "api,web,packages" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:packages"
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -n "types,rules,val" -c "magenta,cyan,yellow" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/shared-types" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/business-rules" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/validators"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
